name: grid/node-status
description: Query a grid node's current state: GPU utilization, running jobs, queue depth, temperature. Uses the grid transport layer (Tailscale now, Reticulum later).

params.name: nodeId
params.description: Target node name or ID. Default: all known nodes.

results.name: gpu
results.description: GPU info: { name, utilization, memoryUsedMb, memoryTotalMb, temperatureC }

results.name: jobs
results.description: Array of running jobs: { pid, type, detail, cpu, mem }

results.name: queue
results.description: Array of queued alloys: { name, path }

results.name: timestamp
results.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the status report
